min_depth.description: Minimum depth at a position before it can be called.

min_base_quality.description: Ignore bases below this Phred quality.

min_fraction.description: Minimum majority-allele fraction required to call a base.

min_mapq.description: Skip alignments below this mapping quality.

max_records.description: Read at most this many alignments (0 reads the whole file).

output.description: Output port name; defaults to the operator name.
